faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Answers to the Main Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about how Kranisa works — from searching to booking with the agency.
faq.a1: No. Kranisa is completely free for travelers — you pay nothing to compare or to reach out to an agency.
faq.q2: How do I know an offer is real and current?
faq.a2: Every offer is checked and added manually. Offers with past dates are automatically removed from search.
faq.q3: Can I book directly on Kranisa?
faq.a3: No. Kranisa connects you with the agency by WhatsApp, phone, or their site — booking itself happens with the agency.
faq.a4: Some agencies pay to appear higher in results. This is always clearly labeled — no sponsored offer is ever hidden.
faq.q5: I run a travel agency — how do I add my offers?
faq.a5: Reach out — listing is free, and we'll get back to you within 48 hours.
faq.q6: Do you only work with agencies from Kosovo and Albania?
faq.a6: Yes. Kranisa focuses only on local agencies from Kosovo and Albania.
